::: {.home-section .home-output-standard role="region" aria-label="How to turn code and tables into evidence"}
::: {.home-output-standard-copy}
**What counts as technical evidence**

Each module alternates explanation, script, table and interpretation. It's not enough to run the code: the session is complete when the output contains a short technical phrase.
:::

::: {.home-output-standard-grid role="list" aria-label="Criteria for reading technical outputs"}
::: {.home-output-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Question**

What decision does the excerpt help you make?
:::

::: {.home-output-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Exit**

What number, contrast or pattern has changed?
:::

::: {.home-output-standard-item role="listitem"}
**Interpretation**

What does this imply for selection or management?
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-orientation role="region" aria-label="Initial course guidance"}
::: {.orientation-copy}
## Before you start

The course works best when the visitor understands the role of each step: choosing an entry point, studying with support and closing each module with their own interpretation.
:::

::: {.orientation-grid role="list" aria-label="How to navigate MGenética"}
::: {.orientation-card role="listitem"}
**Entry point**

Start with Module 01 if this is your first trip along the trail.
:::

::: {.orientation-card role="listitem"}
**Support during reading**

Use search, glossary, and script to retrieve context without abandoning the main sequence.
:::

::: {.orientation-card role="listitem"}
**Closing**

At the end, the certificate records the completion after the quizzes of the 12 modules.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-audience role="region" aria-label="Para quem a MGenética foi desenhada"}
::: {.home-audience-copy}
## Who this trail works best for

MGenética was designed for those who need to connect theory, analysis and applied decision-making. The course does not replace a formal discipline, but organizes a public route to study with method and evidence.
:::

::: {.home-audience-grid role="list" aria-label="Perfis que podem usar a MGenética"}
::: {.home-audience-item role="listitem"}
**Students**

To transform quantitative genetics concepts into reproducible practice.
:::

::: {.home-audience-item role="listitem"}
**Researchers in training**

To review parameters, models, and genomics with controlled examples.
:::

::: {.home-audience-item role="listitem"}
**Technical professionals**

To resume fundamentals before interpreting selection and evaluation outputs.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-start-criteria role="region" aria-label="Criteria for starting to study"}
::: {.home-start-criteria-copy}
**Start when there is time to complete a cycle**

Each session works best when it ends with a small piece of evidence. Before opening the first module, take the time to read, run the script, and write a technical sentence.
:::

::: {.home-start-criteria-grid role="list" aria-label="Criteria for starting a module"}
::: {.home-start-criteria-item role="listitem"}
**30 to 45 min**

Sufficient time for reading, execution and short synthesis.
:::

::: {.home-start-criteria-item role="listitem"}
**R available**

Environment ready to run the module script.
:::

::: {.home-start-criteria-item role="listitem"}
**Clear question**

A biological or technical decision to accompany the reading.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-evidence-copy}
## Why the trail is reliable

The public experiment combines scientific content, controlled simulation and spot checking. This allows you to study complex concepts in a predictable sequence, without depending on registration, an external database or an administrative panel.
:::

::: {.home-evidence-grid role="list" aria-label="Evidence for the MGenética proposal"}
::: {.home-evidence-item role="listitem"}
**Scientific basis**

The path follows classic references in quantitative genetics, genetic assessment and applied genomics.
:::

::: {.home-evidence-item role="listitem"}
**Verifiable practice**

Scripts allow you to repeat the simulation, change parameters and compare the interpretation.
:::

::: {.home-evidence-item role="listitem"}
**Private progress**

Quizzes and certificates work in the browser, without sending personal data.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .platform-statement}
::: {.statement-copy}
## Public platform for applied science education

MGenética organizes content, computational practice and technical progression into a public study experience. The administrative layer must support maintenance, projects and publishing; the visitor experience remains editorial, clear and learning-oriented.
:::

::: {.statement-points}
::: {.statement-point}
**Modular content**

Pages and modules with predictable structure for future editing.
:::

::: {.statement-point}
**Reproducible practice**

Scripts and simulated data connected to the objectives of each module.
:::

::: {.statement-point}
**Static publication**

Performance and stability suitable for GitHub Pages.
:::
:::
:::

## The same cycle is repeated in all modules

::: {.learning-loop-grid}
::: {.learning-loop-card}
**1 · Question**

The content begins with the biological or selection decision that needs to be understood.
:::

::: {.learning-loop-card}
**2 · Parameter**

The module introduces the quantitative concept that explains the observed variation.
:::

::: {.learning-loop-card}
**3 · Code**

The R script transforms the hypothesis into reproducible output with simulated data.
:::

::: {.learning-loop-card}
**4 · Interpretation**

The closure requires a technical phrase linking result, limit and practical consequence.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-outcome-map role="region" aria-label="Resultado esperado depois de estudar"}
::: {.home-outcome-map-copy}
**What should change after a session**

A good session doesn't just end with a page read. It should improve the question, script interpretation, or technical decision you can defend.
:::

::: {.home-outcome-map-grid role="list" aria-label="Resultados esperados de estudo"}
::: {.home-outcome-map-item role="listitem"}
**To understand**

Explain the concept without relying on the quiz answer.
:::

::: {.home-outcome-map-item role="listitem"}
**Test**

Change a simulation and compare the output to the original result.
:::

::: {.home-outcome-map-item role="listitem"}
**Decide**

Write a practical consequence for selection, evaluation, or review.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-lab}
::: {.lab-copy}
## Public content, platform structure

The website presents the study experience. Behind it, the organization needs to remain simple enough that pages, modules, scripts, and posts are maintained by an internal dashboard without contaminating the public experience.
:::

::: {.lab-grid}
::: {.lab-card}
**Signal**

Biological concepts appear before formulas, to preserve context.
:::

::: {.lab-card}
**Model**

R scripts connect simulation, parameters and interpretation.
:::

::: {.lab-card}
**Decision**

Each module points to practical consequences in selection and assessment.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-method}
## How to use the course

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature}
### 1. Study the concept

Each module introduces a central block of animal improvement, avoiding starting with the formula before the biological question.
:::

::: {.feature}
### 2. Run the practice

The scripts in `scripts/` generate simulated data and help observe variation, selection, variance components, and genetic evaluation.
:::

::: {.feature}
### 3. Interpret the result

The activities ask for comparison between estimates, hypotheses and implications for decision-making in improvement programs.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.home-section .home-modules}
## Learning trail

An overview of the four editorial phases. The complete catalog is in the module index.

::: {#learning-trail .phase-preview}
::: {.phase-preview-card}
**01 · Fundamentals**

Animal improvement and bases of quantitative genetics.
:::

::: {.phase-preview-card}
**02 · Data and parameters**

Exploration, variances, heritability and correlations.
:::

::: {.phase-preview-card}
**03 · Modeling**

Mixed models, BLUP, pedigree and kinship.
:::

::: {.phase-preview-card}
**04 · Genomics**

SNPs, quality control, matrices, GWAS and prediction.
:::
:::
